newsitem.title: USA: DuPont boosts dividend; stockholders approve stock split.
newsitem.headline: DuPont boosts dividend; stockholders approve stock split.

text.p: DuPont Co. said Wednesday its directors voted to increase the company's quarterly dividend by 11 percent, while its stockholders approved a two-for-one stock split.
The chemical giant said the quarterly dividend was upped to 63 cents a share from 57 cents a share previously. It is payable on June 12 to stockholders of record May 15.
The new dividend will be equal to 31.5 cents per share following the two-for-one stock split approved by shareholders at the company's annual meeting.
The company said the stock split will be implemented with the distribution of one additional share on June 12 for each share of common stock held of record on May 15.
As of March 7, the company had 579 million shares outstanding.
DuPont's stock was off 37.5 cents at $106.625 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
